description: This source file contains functions to generate YAML configuration schemas for a radio unit's operational hardware (RU OFH) in a 3GPP-compliant system, including sections for logging, expert execution, hardware abstraction layer, cell configurations, metrics, and overall RU OFH settings.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_log_section
methods.description: Populates the YAML node with logging configuration details for the RU OFH.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_expert_execution_section
methods.description: Populates the YAML node with expert execution configuration, including CPU affinities and thread settings.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_hal_section
methods.description: Populates the YAML node with hardware abstraction layer configuration if available.

methods.name: build_ru_ofh_cell_section
methods.description: Constructs a YAML node representing a single cell's configuration for RU OFH.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_section
methods.description: Populates the YAML node with general RU OFH configuration, including GPS and cell configurations.

methods.name: fill_ru_ofh_metrics_section
methods.description: Populates the YAML node with metrics configuration for RU OFH.

methods.name: ocudu::fill_ru_ofh_config_in_yaml_schema
methods.description: Main function to fill the entire RU OFH configuration into a YAML node.
